title: macOS Tahoe — Kimi K2.7 (max thinking)
originalPrompt: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working

questionsAndAnswers.question: Which built-in apps and menus do you want implemented? Pick a realistic subset; 'everything' is too broad for a single session.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Menu bar (Apple, app, status menus); Dock with app launching and window minimization; Finder-style file manager; Desktop with icons and wallpaper; System Settings; Calculator; Notes / TextEdit; Safari browser mock; Terminal; Calendar; Photos viewer; App Store mock

questionsAndAnswers.question: What level of visual/functional fidelity do you want?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Functional apps — Calculator adds, Notes saves, Finder navigates mock folders, Terminal accepts commands, etc.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What tech stack do you prefer?
How should window management behave?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Multiple overlapping, draggable, resizable windows with z-order

questionsAndAnswers.question: Should user data persist across reloads?
Should it work on mobile/tablet screen sizes, or desktop only?
